scope: One GTC meter owner, composed from selected meter leaf state only

state_ref.meaning: Stable logical reference to the complete immutable meter-root value inside the enclosing programme-state snapshot; scoped by that snapshot's ProgrammeId and AttemptId. Not a filesystem path or content hash.

owner_generation.meaning: Meter owner callback generation; equals the meter callback count in the committed meter schedule. Cold 0; advances once per successfully parent-admitted meter callback.

canonical_preimage.kind: Field-complete JSON object for the complete materialized standalone meter state; no GTC envelope, no MeasurementReceipt, no DRC/main owner fields.

top_level_fields.name: frontend_oar_state_hex
top_level_fields.type: Lowercase hex of exact F06OC OAR_MODEL_CALLBACK_STATE_V1 canonical bytes
top_level_fields.shape: 1569 + 120*K bytes, K = instantiated cache-task count; cold 1569 bytes; complete runtime bytes include all actual task rows and optional records.

top_level_fields.name: shared_dv32_state_hex
top_level_fields.type: Lowercase hex of exact SHARED_DV32_STATE_V1 portable bytes

top_level_fields.name: window_k_energy
top_level_fields.rule: All arrays use the exact indices/orders in F06OF/F06M/F06WH schemas; repeat descriptors are fully expanded.

top_level_fields.name: true_peak
top_level_fields.programme_peak_maxima: The 12 maxima are represented exactly once as the two arrays above; do not add a duplicate copy.

top_level_fields.name: integrated_state_hex
top_level_fields.type: Lowercase hex of exact METER_INTEGRATED_STATE_V1 portable bytes

top_level_fields.name: ungated_state_hex
top_level_fields.type: Lowercase hex of exact MEAN_STATE_V1 portable bytes

exclusions: combined 13-owner F06WH whole-state hash or lifecycle owner
ordinary_history, secondary, none_statistics, none_scheduler or override_fifo (DRC has its own GTC root)
programme MeasurementReceipt, finalized flag or GTC phase/status
main four cached drains, codec state or publication ledger
initializer/schema-file reference descriptors in place of materialized frontend/OAR leaf bytes

canonical_encoding.encoding: UTF-8 canonical JSON; recursively sort object keys lexicographically; compact comma/colon separators; ensure_ascii=false; no BOM; no trailing newline.
canonical_encoding.binary32: Serialize each persistent F32 as its exact U32 IEEE-754 bit word in the declared word arrays or exact portable leaf bytes; never decimalize floats.
canonical_encoding.integer_domains: U64/U32/U16/I32 are JSON decimal integers in structured objects; I1 is integer 0 or 1, not JSON boolean.
canonical_encoding.repeats: Expand every *_u32_repeat descriptor to its complete indexed word array before serialization.
canonical_encoding.digest: state_sha256 = SHA-256 over the complete canonical preimage bytes. cold_sha256 is computed by the same serializer over the actual fully constructed cold root for that programme input extent. Never reuse the combined 13-owner cold hash or hash a descriptor/wrapper.

cold_and_reset.source_extent: N is taken from the same validated PreparedJobInput; current GTC count schema remains authoritative and is not generalized by this root representation.
cold_and_reset.frontend_oar: Use the complete selected cold OAR_MODEL_CALLBACK_STATE_V1 constructor for N.
cold_and_reset.shared_dv32: Existing SHARED_DV32_STATE_V1 cold: callback 0, parameters at their specified defaults, 192 positive-zero F32 history words.
cold_and_reset.window_k_energy: Existing F06OF/F06M cold values: startup 3104, pending/processed/callback/ring/window counters at their documented cold values, K/filter accumulators and mantissas positive zero, exponent words at the documented exponent cold (48 where specified).
cold_and_reset.true_peak: Six FIR rows positive zero; true/sample maxima each six values at R32(-15/16).
cold_and_reset.reset: Full programme restart destroys the prior meter root and reconstructs exactly these same leaves cold for the new attempt; no partial leaf reset.

generation_and_receipt.terminal_meter_generation: Q+3 after all meter callbacks are committed; no main cached-drain clock is borrowed.
generation_and_receipt.owner_state: GTC ownerState owner_id=meter, generation equals root.generation, state_ref=owners/meter, state_sha256/cold_sha256 use the preimages above.
generation_and_receipt.owner_receipt: Use the existing GTC ownerReceipt fields: owner_id, before/after generation and SHA, changed, commit_count, transaction_id. A leaf stage produces a pending proposal; parent-admitted commit_count is exactly 1. Fatal callback has no normal after-root receipt and leaves committed meter bytes unchanged except the GTC lifecycle failure state.
generation_and_receipt.measurement_terminal_hash: After the last meter callback's successful parent commit, snapshot SHA-256 of this numeric meter root. Read-only getters run afterward and must not mutate or reserialize a different root. Place the terminal hash in the separate immutable top-level MeasurementReceipt and perform the existing METERING-to-READY parent transition once. The MeasurementReceipt is not part of meter-root bytes, so there is no self-reference.

scope_boundary: This is a local clean owner serialization decision composed from existing approved leaf schemas. It does not promote the F06WH combined cold fixture to a standalone root, does not claim original SDK/DEE ABI equivalence, and does not claim a terminal meter hash has been measured.
